mentions.name: artifacts.iofold.com
mentions.description: A platform for using artifacts (self-contained HTML files with optional image, video, or JSON assets) easily across AI agents. It includes a feedback loop and DocSend-style attributed access gates, so teammates' agents can read and drop comments on specs and storyboards while the author's agent closes the loop by iterating on a new artifact version.
mentions.problem: Using self-contained HTML artifacts across multiple AI agents is cumbersome, and collecting attributed feedback on shared artifacts lacks an easy loop.
mentions.audience: Teams working with AI agents on specs, storyboards, and other shared artifacts
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://artifacts.iofold.com, a way to use artifacts (self contained html + optional assets like image/video/json) easily across agents, with feedback loop and docsend style wttribiti gates.
